title: Dehydration — निर्जलीकरण
warning: Severe dehydration (no urination 8+ hrs, very dry mouth, confusion) needs hospital care.

steps.instruction: Give ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution) if available. Sip slowly — do not gulp.
steps.hint: ORS available at any chemist, or use government ASHA packets

steps.instruction: If ORS not available: Mix 1 liter water + 6 teaspoons sugar + half teaspoon salt.
steps.hint: This homemade ORS is effective and safe

steps.instruction: Give small sips every few minutes. For children under 2: 50-100ml after each loose stool.
steps.hint: Vomiting after drinking means sips are too large — give smaller amounts

steps.instruction: Continue giving fluids even if vomiting occurs. Wait 10 minutes then try again.
Keep the person cool and rested. Fan if hot weather.
Watch for danger signs: very sunken eyes, very dry mouth, not passing urine, unconsciousness.
Continue ORS until fully hydrated and passing normal urine.
